label: OPEN, analyst formulation of the analogy premise of ST I q.19 a.1, attribution…, from finality
description: Some inclination follows every form a thing has, through operation and end as middle terms: each form is the principle of some operation (OPEN), every such operation is directed to an end (OPEN finality principle), and operating through a form toward an end is an inclination following the form (OPEN recognition). The last premise needs both witnesses supplied by the first two.
